title: Orch-OR Visualizer: an interactive, calibrated toy model of orchestrated objective reduction
description: An interactive teaching model of the Penrose–Hameroff Orch-OR theory for iOS and the web: a 3D microtubule lattice in which tubulin superposition spreads by orchestration, accumulates gravitational self-energy, and undergoes objective reduction when the integral of E_G over time reaches ħ, calibrated to Hameroff and Penrose (2014), with a decoherence switch for the Tegmark (2000) and Hagan et al. (2002) estimates and a Diósi–Penrose calculator. Includes the arXiv-style paper draft.
